column1: # French display names for staple foods (used by tools/build_db.py).
# Format: <key>\t<French name>[\t<*>[\t<fluent>]]. The key is an OpenNutrition id (fd_…) or the exact English
# name of an everyday / prepared food (first match wins). The English name is kept in the
# full-text index (alt column), so English searches still find these foods. Renamed foods
# are stored with their English name in `name_en` and flagged as staples (`staple` column),
# ranked first by the app's search when they match. "*" marks the reference food of a
# family (e.g. "Œufs entiers" among the eggs), ranked before the others. <fluent> forces the
# bundled Fluent Emoji icon (App/Resources/Assets.xcassets/FoodEmoji/<fluent>), for staples
